'''Camp Forty''' was a military camp established by [[Lightning Battalion]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] during a vital stage of the [[Icarii Campaign]]. It was there that [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Abal Karda]] held the [[Icarii]] leader [[Selestrine]] captive before decapitating her.
